zh-CN.name: 近 30 天研究

en-US.name: Last 30 Days
en-US.shortDesc: Research public discussions from the last 30 days. Requires Python and selected source tools. TikTok and Instagram use the operator's paid API or public discovery and yt-dlp. Any optional SSH route, account or browser session requires separate setup and authorization.
